title: Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.37378v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $\Delta z=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). translated_title: Do-JEPA：从掩码到干预的潜在世界模型
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型通过预测接下来会发生什么来进行训练，因此其目标函数中没有任何部分能够将一个动作所导致的结果与仅仅是同时发生的现象区分开来。诸如 C-JEPA 之类的对象掩码模型是对预测器“能看到什么”进行干预；而我们的方法是对“物理上实际发生什么”进行干预。从一个保存的模拟器状态出发，我们分别在动作 $a$ 和参考动作 $a_{\varnothing}$ 下运行动力学过程，并训练模型预测两个潜在未来之间的差异 $\Delta z=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$。由此得到的目标函数 Do-JEPA 包含：效果损失、支撑损失（动作作用于何处）、传播损失（其影响传播到哪里）以及不变性损失（哪些内容不应改变）。在一个具有对象对齐变量的合成系统中，支撑监督在 99.95% 的测试用例中成功找到了被直接干预的对象，而稀疏动作掩码在每一个用例中都会将动作错误地分配到干扰槽位；并且响应起始监督……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Do-JEPA 通过在同一模拟器状态下对比动作干预与参考动作所产生的潜在未来差异，并借助效果、支撑、传播和不变性四种损失，将自监督预训练从“对预测器可见内容做掩码”推进到“对物理因果干预建模”，从而让潜在世界模型能够识别动作的真正因果效应。
en_tdlr: Do-JEPA trains latent world models to predict the difference between latent futures under an action versus a reference action, using effect, support, propagation, and invariance losses to shift pretraining from masking what the predictor sees to intervening on what physically happens, enabling identification of true causal effects of actions.
